reply_text:
I didn't record 25 November. Our records say 30 November 2026, so I asked Ilse about it in a thread reply in #north-team instead.

- **Signed contract:** the 2025–2026 renewal order form, signed 21 Nov 2025, sets the end of the current term, which is the renewal date, at 30 November 2026.
- **Account page:** the Brackenwater page, last updated 30 Sep 2026, also says the term ends Nov 30.
- **Ilse's date:** I found nothing that moves it to 25 November. In the reply I asked whether 25 Nov is a new date from an amendment, or an internal deadline such as a target signing date. I also asked her to point me to the source, and said I'd keep 30 Nov until then.

There's a third date I didn't mention to Ilse. A CRM note from 10 Feb 2026 says the renewal date is December 31, 2026. It contradicts the signed contract, so it's probably wrong, but someone may want to correct it.

The reply named only the renewal date, which counts as an operational fact here, so no approval was needed. It included no prices or other money terms from the contract.
